sharingBasis: Every entry below answers Play's sharing question false on the service-provider basis. The ground fact: in Cloud mode the user's messages and attachments leave the device, reach AGI Cloud, and are forwarded server-side to the model provider serving the request; sign-in identity is handled by Clerk and push delivery by the push service. Those subprocessors are listed at https://agiworkforce.com/subprocessors and process the data on AGI's behalf, not for their own purposes. What the source tree proves: every outbound request from the device goes to an AGI-controlled host (apps/mobile/lib/constants.ts) plus Clerk and the push service, so no third party receives data directly from the device, and apps/mobile/package.json declares no analytics, crash-reporting or ad SDK. Whether the exception covers each subprocessor rests on the data-processing terms behind that list, which this repo cannot verify. LISTING-METADATA-ANDROID.json data_safety.data_shared is false to match.
optionalityBasis: Every entry is optional because Cloud sign-in is optional. A signed-out user who has completed onboarding lands in Local Mode and is never redirected to a sign-in wall (apps/mobile/app/_layout.tsx), and Local Mode is prevented from reaching AGI hosts by apps/mobile/lib/egressGuard.ts.

collectedData.backedBy: Clerk sign-in only (apps/mobile/app/(auth)/login.tsx). Never collected in Local Mode.
Collected only if the user's sign-in method provides it (apps/mobile/app/(auth)/login.tsx).
Cloud-mode chat content, uploaded to AGI Cloud and processed by the model provider serving the request. Local Mode uploads nothing.
Image attachments picked for a Cloud message (apps/mobile/src/features/media/photo-picker.ts) and the Cloud profile photo, which is uploaded to Clerk (apps/mobile/src/features/settings/index.tsx).

A document attached to a Cloud message through expo-document-picker (apps/mobile/app/(app)/chat/[id].tsx:703, apps/mobile/app/(app)/(tabs)/chat.tsx:596). Apple has no separate documents type, so it maps onto the same NSPrivacyCollectedDataTypeOtherUserContent entry the privacy manifest already declares for message content; Play has a distinct type and needs its own row.
The account identifier carried by every authenticated cloud request (apps/mobile/services/api.ts).

An app-generated UUID from apps/mobile/lib/deviceId.ts, registered with the push token by apps/mobile/services/notifications.ts. Created only when push is enabled; it is not an advertising identifier.
